pages.title: Browse Resources
pages.text: Open Icon in a tree or skill form, then Choose... . Textures previews PNGs under textures/ from loaded mods and resource packs. The type button cycles Textures, Items, and Spells. Search by namespace or path, select an entry, then Apply.

pages.title: Texture IDs
pages.text: An image ID identifies a client PNG, such as mastery:textures/gui/sprites/graph/rune.png. Any loaded PNG ID can be typed directly, including paths outside textures/. The full image scales into the icon square. Item IDs render item models; native spell IDs resolve their icon.

pages.title: Books Match Skills
pages.text: The skill map and matching Skill Book cover use the same icon resolution. Change a branch icon and its generic Skill Book updates. Every client needs the referenced resource pack. A datapack export includes IDs, not image assets.

pages.title: Root XP Outline
pages.text: In normal player mode, each specialization root gains a clockwise XP outline from its top. It follows the selected circle, square, diamond, hexagon, pentagon, or triangle. The filled length is current-level XP divided by the next level requirement; capped trees show a full outline.

pages.title: Shapes and Points
pages.text: Roots default to pentagons, passives to circles, actives to rounded squares, and modifiers to triangles. Explicit appearance shapes override these defaults. Each root shows its available tree points above the icon. Promoted roots show their own tree currency. Appearance scale controls node size; root_scale multiplies root size, defaulting to 1.3 in data.
